about: Data: whether each station in range files what the field strength needs: a position, power and an antenna height.
heights_basis: The effective height filed (fxm_ant.eff_hgtmax), else the highest effective height by azimuth (fxm_ant_hgt.eff_hgt), else the height above ground (fxm_ant.hgt_agl) taken as effective height over flat ground.
mobile_default_basis: Administration policy: a land mobile station (ML) that files no height is taken at 3 m, a vehicle antenna. Recorded as an assumption.

power.I: e.i.r.p.: 2.15 dB is taken off to give e.r.p. (gain of a half-wave dipole over isotropic)
power.other: Any other reference is treated as e.r.p. and recorded as an assumption

transmit_rows: Antenna rows marked TX, or with no direction, give the power: the highest filed.

reasons.no_position: Its position is not filed, so its distance to Finland cannot be worked out.
reasons.no_height: It files no antenna height, and it is not a land mobile station that could take the default.

notes: Reasons are tried in the order above.
